title: Eleven Weeks at a Time
subtitle: 航天探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 航天探索（宇宙探索·宇航员与航天）
meta: 主题语境：航天探索（宇宙探索·宇航员与航天）　|　核心词汇：absence　|　正文 303 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 absence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother's ① absence was eleven weeks at a time, and it was not a secret and it was not discussed: she worked at the tracking station on the coast and came home in the eleventh week. During her ② absence my father did everything wrong, and she never once corrected him, and I have never decided whether that was kindness or arithmetic.

The ③ absence of noise in that house when she was gone was the thing I noticed, and I notice it still. ④ In the absence of anybody to say otherwise, my father let me stay up until eleven, and I have never told her and I never will.

⑤ In her absence the letters came anyway, eleven of them, written on the Sunday and posted on the Monday, and I was eleven and I read two, and the absence was the whole of it, and I have never said so.

The ⑥ absence of mind she had in 1979, when she put the milk in the cupboard, is the only time I ever saw her fail at anything, and she said it was not failure but arithmetic: eleven weeks of somebody else's house will do that to you, and no absence, she said, is ever really over.

The ⑦ absence, meaning the fact of her not being there, was the shape of my childhood, and I did not know that until 1998. My grandmother said ⑧ absence makes the heart grow fonder, and my mother said it makes the heart grow accurate, and I have decided the second is true. The  absence I remember best is the last one, in 1989: eleven weeks away, and she came back to a house that had been sold. The  absence of anything to say about it, on either side, lasted thirty-one years, and then she died, and that was that.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 缺席；不在场；不在
B. n. 缺乏；不存在（absence of ...）
C. n. 离家／外出期间；不在的那段时间
D. n. （亲人的）不在身边；离别
E. 固定搭配：in the absence of ... 在缺乏／没有……的情况下
F. 固定搭配：absence of mind 心不在焉；走神
G. 固定搭配：in one's absence 在某人不在期间
H. 固定搭配：absence makes the heart grow fonder 别久情更深

items.q: My mother's absence was eleven weeks
During her absence my father did everything
The absence of noise in that house
In the absence of anybody to say
In her absence the letters came
The absence of mind she had in 1979
The absence, meaning the fact of her
absence makes the heart grow fonder

answers.why: absence 意为“不在、离家”，我母亲每次离家就是十一周，她在海岸上的跟踪站工作。
during her absence 意为“在她离家的那段时间里”，她不在的那段时间里，我父亲样样都做错。
the absence of noise 意为“没有声音、安静得反常”，她走后屋里那种没有声音的状态，是我注意到的东西。
in the absence of ... 意为“在缺乏……的情况下、因为没有……”，因为没有别的人反对，父亲就让我熬到十一点。
in her absence 意为“在她不在期间”，她不在的期间，信还是照样来，一共十一封。
absence of mind 意为“心不在焉、走神”，1979 年她把牛奶放进了碗柜，那是我唯一一次见她出错。
the absence 意为“（亲人的）不在身边、离别”，她不在身边这件事，是我整个童年的形状。
absence makes the heart grow fonder 意为“别久情更深、小别胜新婚”，祖母这么说，而我母亲说离别只会让心变得更准确。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我母亲每次离家就是十一周，她在海岸上的跟踪站工作，第十一周回家。（absence）
她不在的那段时间里，我父亲样样都做错，而她从未纠正过他。（during one's absence）
她走后屋里那种没有声音的状态，是我唯一注意到的东西。（the absence of）
因为没有别的人反对，父亲就让我熬到十一点，这件事我从未告诉过她。（in the absence of）
1979 年她把牛奶放进了碗柜，那是我唯一一次见她心不在焉。（absence of mind）
祖母说别久情更深，而我母亲说离别只会让心变得更准确。（absence makes the heart grow fonder）
answers: My mother's absence was eleven weeks at a time; she worked at the tracking station on the coast and came home in the eleventh week.
During her absence my father did everything wrong, and she never once corrected him.
The absence of noise in that house when she was gone was the only thing I noticed.
In the absence of anybody to say otherwise, my father let me stay up until eleven, and I have never told her.
The absence of mind she had in 1979, when she put the milk in the cupboard, is the only time I saw her fail at anything.
My grandmother said absence makes the heart grow fonder, and my mother said it makes the heart grow accurate.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 absence 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My mother's absence was eleven weeks at a time, and during her absence my father did everything wrong.
The absence of noise in that house when she was gone was the thing I noticed, and I notice it still.
In the absence of anybody to say otherwise my father let me stay up until eleven, and in her absence the letters came anyway.
The absence of mind she had in 1979, when she put the milk in the cupboard, was the only time I saw her fail.
The absence, meaning the fact of her not being there, was the shape of my childhood.
My grandmother said absence makes the heart grow fonder, and the absence of anything to say about it lasted thirty-one years.
